{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained positive sentiment (e.g., >0.5) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion after sharp spikes.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment history includes multiple consecutive positive values (e.g., 0.5+), indicating delayed market reaction.",
    "Apply downward bias correction if model consistently overpredicts prices during low-sentiment periods (e.g., sentiment < 0.3).",
    "Cap forecast growth after 3 consecutive days of upward sentiment to prevent overshoot.",
    "If true outcome is significantly below forecast (e.g., >15% gap), reduce forecast by 10-20% for next period, especially if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "When sentiment history shows a recent spike (e.g., 0.67), adjust forecast to reflect potential short-term volatility and downward correction."
  ]
}
